row.title: Hand over a matter
row.subtitle: Test version: the assistant emails for you, only within what you confirm.

intro: Tell me the matter in your own words: whom to contact and their email address, what to ask for, whether to set up a meeting and until when. I read it back to you, and nothing is sent until you confirm.

request.label: Your matter
request.placeholder: Contact Carlos at carlos@example.com, ask for the updated proposal, set up a meeting to discuss it and follow up until Friday. Keep me copied.

result.sent: Sent. Replies to this matter are kept with it.
result.notSent: The email could not be sent yet. Try again in a moment.
result.sending: Another request is sending this email right now. Check again in a moment to see how it went. It will not be sent twice.
result.unknown: We could not confirm that the email went out. It may have been sent, so it will not be sent again. Your copy shows whether it arrived.
result.unknownNoCopy: We could not confirm that the email went out. It may have been sent, so it will not be sent again.
result.cancelled: Matter cancelled. Nothing more will be sent.

errors.stale: The draft changed. Check it again before confirming.
errors.notAllowed: This is outside what you confirmed, so nothing was sent.
errors.unavailable: The assistant is not available for your account yet.

page.sending: This reply is being sent right now. Open the matter again in a moment to see how it went.
page.notSent: The reply could not be sent yet. Try again in a moment.
page.unknown: We could not confirm that the reply went out. It may have been sent, so it will not be sent again.
page.notFound: This matter is no longer available.
page.loadFailed: This matter could not be loaded right now. Check your connection and try again.

kind.new_person: Someone new wrote or was copied in
kind.unclear: I could not tell what this reply wants
kind.bounce: An email could not be delivered

reason.money: It is about money or prices, which I never handle.
reason.contract: It is about a contract or a signature, which I never handle.
reason.not_covered: It asks for something outside what you confirmed.
reason.new_person: It involves someone who is not part of this matter.
reason.asks_other_contact: It asks me to write to someone else.
reason.auto_reply_off: Replies go out only after you approve them.
reason.unverified_sender: I could not verify the sender, so I ask you first.
reason.content_guard: The draft mentions something I never send on my own.
reason.cap_reached: Today's limit for this matter was reached. More replies are kept unread.
reason.read_failed: I could not read this reply. Please read it in your copy.
reason.loop: This thread went back and forth many times today, so I stopped reading it until tomorrow.
